note: Hand-researched sources that no automated route can reach. Roblox games are covered by scripts/discover-sources.mjs and scripts/mine-discovery-corpus.mjs; this file is for the mobile daily-link titles, where there is no group API to interrogate. Every entry records how it was established so a later reader can re-check it rather than trust it.

games.linkTtlNote: Smaller bundles expire in about a day; larger event bundles can run up to a week. Treat 24h as the default and let a resolved 200 extend it.
